definitions.gloss: play; jest; something done for fun
definitions.explanation: Something done in play or as a joke, not in earnest. Literary in tone; common in the adverbial {戯|たわむ}れに (for fun, on a whim) and in the phrase {恋|こい}の{戯|たわむ}れ (a flirtation).

examples.english: I drew a picture just for fun.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほんの→ほんの：22755_honno⟧{戯|たわむ}れだった。
examples.english: It was only a bit of fun.

examples.japanese: {子猫|こねこ}たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{戯|たわむ}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまう。
examples.english: Watching the kittens at play, I lose track of time.

notes:
The noun form of {戯|たわむ}れる (to play, to frolic, to flirt). The word often suggests something light or not to be taken seriously, sometimes with a hint of reproach.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戯|たわむ}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: for fun, on a whim
- ⟦ほんの→ほんの：22755_honno⟧{戯|たわむ}れ: just a bit of fun
- ⟦{恋|こい}→恋：02208_koi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{戯|たわむ}れ: a flirtation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧: joke — the everyday word
- ⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧: play — the plain, everyday word
